conditions.title: Infertility
symptoms: Difficulty conceiving after 12 months (or 6 months if >35)
conditions.evaluation: Review of medical history, semen analysis (if applicable), and targeted blood tracking.
conditions.treatment: Guided ovulation tracking, lifestyle adjustments, and possible referral for further ART interventions.

conditions.title: PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome)
redFlags: Prolonged heavy bleeding after months of no periods
conditions.evaluation: Detailed clinical history mapped with hormonal profiles and ultrasound findings.
conditions.treatment: Lifestyle modifications, hormonal balance strategies, and managing metabolic risks.

conditions.title: Menstrual Irregularities
redFlags: Bleeding requiring pad changes every 1-2 hours
conditions.evaluation: Thorough tracking review and specific endocrine/hormonal test recommendations.
conditions.treatment: Tailored approach ranging from lifestyle fixes to hormonal support therapies.

conditions.title: Vaginal Infections & Discharge
conditions.evaluation: Symptom description analysis and swab guidance.
conditions.treatment: Targeted pharmaceutical or holistic advice for balancing the vaginal microbiome.

conditions.title: Menopause & Perimenopause
redFlags: Any bleeding occurring 12+ months after the last period
conditions.evaluation: Assessment of symptom severity and quality of life impact.
conditions.treatment: Navigating hormone replacement options, non-hormonal therapies, and lifestyle shifts.

conditions.title: Pelvic Floor Concerns
redFlags: Sudden inability to urinate or control bowels
conditions.evaluation: Symptom reporting to classify the type of dysfunction.
conditions.treatment: Pelvic floor exercises, lifestyle modifications, and physiotherapy guidance.

faqs.question: Who is this for?
faqs.answer: Women looking for a private, professional, online consultation regarding their reproductive and gynecological health, from infertility to hormonal cycles.

faqs.question: Is it online only?
faqs.answer: Yes, all consultations are 100% online through secure video calls. Physical examinations are not performed.

faqs.question: Can I book from outside Nigeria?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Location is not a barrier for our online consultations. Just ensure the time zone matches when booking on Calendly.

faqs.question: What happens after I book?
faqs.answer: You will receive a confirmation email with details instructions and the payment process required to secure your slot.

faqs.question: Do I need tests before booking?
faqs.answer: No. If you have previous test results, you can bring them. If not, Dr. Maryam will advise on what tests are necessary during the call.

faqs.question: Will you prescribe medication?
faqs.answer: Prescriptions will depend on exactly what was diagnosed during the consultation and local regulatory allowances for telemedicine. Appropriate recommendations or referrals will always be provided.

faqs.question: Can my husband join a fertility consult?
faqs.answer: Yes, we highly encourage both partners to be present for Fertility Strategy Sessions.

faqs.question: What is your reschedule/cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We require at least 24 hours notice for rescheduling. Please view our full policy for details on cancellations and refunds.

faqs.question: Where do I go for vaginismus care?
faqs.answer: For concerns relating to Vaginismus or unconsummated marriages, please visit our dedicated platform at BeyondVaginismus.com.
